defs.def: to move past or to the other side of sb/sth 通过；走过

ex.s: The walls of the houses have a lot of holes in them to allow wind to pass through.
ex.t: 房屋的墙壁上有很多洞，可以让风通过。

ex.s: I found it difficult, but still hoped to pass.
ex.t: 我觉得很难，但仍希望能通过。

ex.s: This knowledge is passed down through families, which means that new generations continue to use ancient methods of agriculture to maintain the terraces.
ex.t: 这些知识通过家庭传承，这意味着新一代人继续使用古老的农业方法来维护梯田。

ex.s: Terrafugia says an owner would need to pass a test and complete 20 hours of flying time to be able to fly the Transition, a requirement pilots would find redatively easy to meet.
ex.t: Terrafugia表示，车主需要通过一项测试并完成20小时的飞行时间才能驾驶Transition，飞行员会觉得这是很容易满足的要求。

ex.s: Mann said Terrafugia was helped by the Federal Aviation  Administration’s decision five years ago to create a separate set of standards for light sport aircraft, which are lower than those pilots of larger planes Terrafugia says an owner would need to pass a test and complete 20 hours of flying time to be able to fly the Transition, a requirement pilots would find relatively easy to meet.
ex.t: 曼说，Terrafugia得益于联邦航空管理局五年前做出的为轻型运动飞机制定一套单独标准的决定，这些标准低于大型飞机飞行员所需的标准。Terrafugia表示，车主需要通过一项测试并完成20小时的飞行时间才能驾驶Transition，飞行员会觉得这是很容易满足的要求。

ex.s: For all the feelings readers attach to stories, literature is a numbers game, and the test of time is extremely difficult to pass.
ex.t: 尽管读者对故事倾注诸多情感，文学终究是一场数字游戏，而时间的考验极难通过。

ex.s: If people remove food and attractants from their yards and campsites, grizzlies will typically pass by without trouble.
ex.t: 如果人们把食物和引诱物从自家院子和营地清除，灰熊通常会顺利通过而不惹麻烦。

ex.s: SoFi Stadium requires you to park strictly in your assigned zone, and guests must enter through the exact gate indicated on their color-coded digital parking pass.
ex.t: SoFi体育场要求你严格在指定区域停车，并且宾客必须通过其彩色编码电子停车证上标明的确切入口进入。

ex.s: I knew then that ____52____ passing or failing tests, studying was about hard work and effort.
ex.t: 那时我明白了，无论____52____是通过还是不及格考试，学习关乎的是努力和付出。

defs.def: to go or move in the direction mentioned 沿某方向前进；向某方向移动
to make sth move in the direction or into the position mentioned 使沿某方向移动；使达到某位置

ex.s: If you miss two PASS sessions in a row, you will be deregistered and your place will be given to someone on the waiting list.
ex.t: 如果你连续错过两次PASS课程，你将被取消注册，你的位置将给候补名单上的人。

defs.def: to give sth to sb by putting it into their hands or in a place where they can easily reach it 给；递；传递

ex.s: Carson proves that a simple lyric form that has been passed down through the ages can still ____50____ (employ) today to draw attention to important truths.
ex.t: 卡森证明了一种世代相传的简单抒情形式今天仍可以（第50空，employ）来引起人们对重要真理的关注。

ex.s: Joy of reading passed on in the family.
ex.t: 在家庭中传递的阅读之乐。

ex.s: But instead of passing it through the hole to the dog, they would then pull it out of its reach.
ex.t: 但他们没有把它穿过洞递给狗，而是把它拉到狗够不着的地方。

ex.s: We've all known people who run out of steam before they reach life's halfway mark． I'm not talking about those who fail to get to the top． We can't all get there． I'm talking about people who have stopped learning on growing because they have adopted the fixed attitudes and opinions that all too often come with passing years．
ex.t: 我们都认识这样的人，他们在到达人生的中点之前就失去了动力。我说的不是那些没能登上顶峰的人。我们不可能都到达顶峰。我说的是那些停止学习和成长的人，因为他们接受了那些常常伴随岁月流逝而来的固定态度和观念。

ex.s: When your children are finished with their magazines encourage them to pass their issue on to a sibling or other family member.
ex.t: 当孩子们读完杂志，鼓励他们把那期传给兄弟姐妹或其他家人。

ex.s: I thought that we would just be passing out dinners to those in need, but I found out we would be doing everything from preparing to serving the dinner.
ex.t: 我以为我们只是分发晚餐给那些需要帮助的人，但我发现我们要做的事情从准备到服务晚餐无所不包。

ex.s: Long before reading and writing became widely spread and available, oral storytelling had already been a form that the wisdom and knowledge of the people were passed down from elders to children.
ex.t: 早在读写广泛普及之前，口头讲故事就已是人们将智慧和知识从长辈传给孩子的一种形式。

ex.s: That taught me a valuable   54   and I pass it on to the people who   55   in the market.
ex.t: 那给了我一个宝贵的___54___，我把它传给在市场上___55___的人。

ex.s: If a basketball star is. for example，trying to gain a high personal point total，he may take a shot himself when it would be better to pass the ball to a teammate，affecting the team's performance.
ex.t: 例如，如果一个篮球明星试图获得更高的个人得分总数，在把球传给队友可能更好的情况下，他可能会自己投篮，从而影响球队的表现。

defs.def: to kick, hit or throw the ball to a player of your own side 球类运动

ex.s: Each town has its own traditional ____30____, and every family keeps a recipe passed from one generation to another.
ex.t: 每个小镇都有自己的传统____30____，每个家庭都保存着代代相传的食谱。

defs.def: to be given to another person after first belonging to sb else, especially after the first person has died 转移给，遗留给（继承人等）
to become greater than a particular total 数量
to change from one state or condition to another 转变；变化；过渡
when time passes, it goes by 推移；逝去

ex.s: Two months passed.
ex.t: 它是由猫妈妈教的。

ex.s: The best books are the ones that open further as time passes.
ex.t: 但记住，是你自己必须成长、阅读和重读，才能更好地理解你的朋友们。

defs.def: to spend time, especially when you are bored or waiting for sth 消磨；度过；打发

ex.s: We talked endlessly through the curtain to pass the time, without seeing each other.
ex.t: 我们隔着帘子不停地聊天来消磨时间，彼此看不见对方。

ex.s: How to pass the waiting time.
ex.t: 如何打发等待的时间。

ex.s: How to pass the waiting time.
ex.t: 如何打发等待的时间。

ex.s: How to pass the waiting time.
ex.t: 如何打发等待的时间。

ex.t: 这位男士在城市通票上花了多少钱？

ex.s: How much did the man spend on the city passes?
ex.t: 这位男士在城市通票上花了多少钱？

defs.def: to come to an end; to be over 结束；完结

ex.s: You do not have to be a fan to recognise the skill of professional players - how they use their bodies to pass, score and defend can be amazing to see - or to fell the excitement of a game ending with a surprising twist.
ex.t: 你不必是球迷，也能看得出职业选手的技巧——他们如何用身体来传球、得分和防守，看起来令人惊叹——也能感受到以出人意料的转折结束的一场比赛所带来的兴奋。

defs.def: to achieve the required standard in an exam, a test, etc. 及格；合格
to test sb and decide that they are good enough, according to an agreed standard 准予通过；承认合格
to accept a proposal, law, etc. by voting 经表决通过（动议、法律等）

ex.s: Over 28 states have passed laws related to pollinator habitat protection and pesticide use.
ex.t: 超过28个州已通过与传粉昆虫栖息地保护和杀虫剂使用相关的法律。

defs.def: to be allowed 得到允许

ex.s: Many airlines now allow passengers to print their boarding passes online ______ their valuable time.
ex.t: 如今许多航空公司允许乘客在线打印登机牌，______他们的贵重物品……

defs.def: to happen; to be said or done 发生；说出（或做出）
to say that you do not know the answer to a question, especially during a quiz 不知道，过（尤在回答竞赛问题时所用）

ex.s: Before I knew it an hour had passed and it was time to move on to lunch.
ex.t: 不知不觉中，一个小时过去了，该去吃午饭了。

ex.s: He waved and yelled at passing cars but was careful not to show down.
ex.t: 他挥了挥手，对路过的汽车大喊大叫，但小心翼翼地不屈服。

ex.s: At mile 3, I passed a sign: “GO FOR IT, RUNNERS!”
ex.t: 在3英里处，我经过一块牌子：“加油，跑者！”

ex.s: For the “unable” scenario, the experimenter would again move the treat towards the hole while the dog watched, but “accidentally” drop it before they could pass it through.
ex.t: 在“无能为力”的情形中，实验者会再次当着狗的面把零食移向小孔，但在穿过小孔之前“不小心”把它掉在了地上。

ex.s: “Our hope is to have a clean, attractant-free place where bears can pass through without learning bad habits,“ says James Jonkel, longtime biologist who manages bears in and around Missoula.
ex.t: 我们的希望是拥有一个干净、无诱饵的地方，让熊可以穿行而过而不养成坏习惯，长期在米苏拉及周边管理熊的生物学家詹姆斯·琼克尔说。

ex.s: A few days passed, and I hadn’t heard anything from my brother.
ex.t: 几天过去了，我还没收到我哥哥的任何消息。

ex.s: But as days passed, the arugula went bad.
ex.t: 但随着日子一天天过去，芝麻菜坏了。

ex.s: Time passed quickly.
ex.t: 时间过得很快。

ex.s: Since passengers are just passing through, our interactions are brief.
ex.t: 由于乘客只是路过，因此我们的互动时间很短。

ex.s: This is how everyone learned to read． We would start off with sentences， then paragraphs， and then stories． It seemed an unending journey， but even as a six﹣year﹣old girl I realized that knowing how to read could open many doors． When mom said， "The C﹣A﹣N﹣D﹣Y is hidden on the top shelf，" I knew where the candy was． My progress in reading raised my curiosity， and I wanted to know everything． I often found myself telling my mom to drive more slowly， so that I could read all of the road signs we passed．
ex.t: 每个人都是这样学会阅读的。我们从句子开始，然后是段落，再然后是故事。这似乎是一段永无止境的旅程，但即使作为一个六岁的女孩，我也意识到学会阅读能打开许多扇门。当妈妈说：“C-A-N-D-Y藏在最上面的架子上”时，我知道糖果在哪里。我在阅读上的进步激发了我的好奇心，我想知道一切。我经常叫妈妈开慢一点，这样我就能读出我们路过的所有路标。

ex.s: He was facing health issues and his wife of thirty-five years had passed away a few months earlier.
ex.t: 他正面临健康问题，而与他结发三十五年的妻子在几个月前去世了。

ex.s: PASS involves weekly sessions where you work in groups to tackle specially prepared problem sets, based around a unit of study you’re enrolled in.
ex.t: PASS包含每周的小组活动，你以小组形式攻克特别准备的问题集，围绕你所修的一个学习单元。

ex.s: Should you come across waste paper thrown out of a passing car, pick it up.
ex.t: 如果你看到从经过的汽车里扔出的废纸，请把它捡起来。

ex.s: The age of pen-and-paper letter writing may have passed.
ex.t: 纸笔写信的时代可能已经过去了。

ex.s: We passed it, he tried to put it in his mouth, he tried bouncing it, rolling it, sitting on it, throwing it.
ex.t: 我们路过它时，他试图把它放进嘴里，又试着弹它、滚它、坐在上面、扔它。

ex.s: He passed milky white waterfalls and mountains in many shades of blue.
ex.t: 他经过乳白色的瀑布和呈现各种蓝色调的山峦。

ex.s: What is a direct result of the Act passed in 1934?

defs.def: an official document or ticket that shows that you have the right to enter or leave a place, to travel on a bus or train, etc. 通行证；车票；乘车证

ex.s: Looking back, I now see that this would be the first in a series of timely opportunities that my old self would have let pass, but that this new and more confident Alice enthusiastically seized.

ex.s: For those wishing to park near friends, all vehicles must have passes for the same zone and arrive together — spaces cannot be saved.

ex.s: Make sure to download your parking pass to your smartphone before arrival.

ex.s: Obtain a parking pass.
